title: AI Intelligence Leads' Traffic Gain Drops from 69% to 20%
summary:
OpenAI and Anthropic are seeing their market advantage diminish as intelligence upgrades no longer drive the same volume of user migration. A 10 point intelligence lead now attracts only 20% more developer traffic, whereas the same level of improvement generated nearly 69% more traffic in late 2025. This trend indicates that the appetite for raw model power is waning as tools reach a baseline of effectiveness.

Internal data from Cognition suggests terms like "intelligence saturated" now apply to many software engineering tasks, shifting user priorities toward speed and cost. Some researchers noted that the latest Claude Opus 5.5 is sufficiently reliable that they no longer feel a strong need to test newer versions for marginal intelligence gains.
